en.caption:
One calendar, both of your plans.

Events are colored three ways: yours, theirs, and the ones you're both in.
A single day, or a trip with a start and an end date.
Every event has its own comments, so the back-and-forth stays with the plan.
Your dating anniversary, birthdays, and wedding anniversary show up on their own.

#couples #couplegoals #couplesapp #sharedcalendar #datenight #relationshipgoals #DearApp
en.threads: Every event carries its own comment thread. Without that, the planning happens in a chat app and the calendar is just a record of what you already decided.
